'''Zephyr''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots that turns sneaking into a high jump. Higher levels add a slow descent and a charged updraft.

== Obtaining ==
The [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]] gives Zephyr I. No recipe, trade or loot table gives levels II or III.

In 1.12.2 the elegy stores the old <code>main:zephyr</code>, which becomes Zephyr I the first tick the boots are worn.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_zephyr.json}}</ref> The old enchantment's maximum level is I, so two elegies cannot be combined into a level II book. Higher levels come from applying another elegy to boots that already have Zephyr, since the conversion adds its level to the existing one, or from combining two boots with the same level in an [[anvil]]. Applying an elegy to boots with Zephyr III gives Zephyr IV, which works like level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/zephyr.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
All effects are checked every tick while the boots are worn.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/zephyr.json}}</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Level !! Effect
|-
| I || While sneaking, the wearer has {{EffectLink|Jump Boost}} VII (renewed for 0.25 seconds each tick), and dust plume particles rise around their feet.
|-
| II || As level I, and the wearer also has {{EffectLink|Slow Falling}} II while sneaking.
|-
| III || As level II, and the wearer can charge an updraft. After sneaking for a total of 45 ticks (2.25 seconds), a dust burst and a chime mark the charge as ready. Releasing sneak while in the air and under Slow Falling then plays a wind burst sound and gives {{EffectLink|Levitation}} XIII for 1 second, launching the wearer upward.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/zephyr_execute.mcfunction}}</ref> Releasing sneak in the air without enough charge only plays the sound. Any release in the air resets the charge.
|}

The sneak time is counted with the player's <code>sneak_time</code> statistic, so it builds up across separate sneaks until it is reset by a release in the air.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/scoreboard/create_scoreboards.mcfunction}}</ref>

Zephyr's anvil cost multiplier is 0.

}}

== Trivia ==
* Zephyrus is the Greek god of the west wind. In myth, Hyacinthus was loved by both Zephyrus and Apollo, which is why the Zephyr blessing is the [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]].
